correctness.rationale: The total-domination/step-two vertex-cover equivalence is exact for all \(n\ge3\), including duplicate-edge \(n=4\). On each auxiliary odd cycle all maximum independent words have exactly one 00 edge. Pair witnesses are built by alternating arcs and one inserted zero, while any triple permits a parity-consistent assignment forcing three 00 edges; even cycles have precisely two alternating maximum sets. All supports and coefficients then factor between disjoint components. The integral wedge decomposition follows from connected-graph spanning-tree collapse and the simplicial join/smash-suspension identity. The embedded independent direct-neighborhood verifier returned MINIMUM_TOTAL_DOMINATION_CYCLE_PASS 93592 60 11.

value.rationale: All coefficient, exact-support and integral homotopy invariants are natural for the concept class of optimal total dominating configurations. The \(n\equiv2\pmod4\) topological transition from wedge circles to wedge three-spheres (rank \(b_m^2\)) cannot be inferred from the classical domination number or optimizer count, and provides an infinite-family structural benchmark. This is neither an arbitrary finite slice nor a generic fixed-weight resubstitution: the step-two decomposition and extremal cyclic trace structure are used to solve an all-cycle classification.
